text_blocks.text: Speaking of refs, y'all in Boston. Y'all in Boston. That was classic. I tell y'all, I dead near jumped my motherfucking ass out the window. I told your ass go grab the camera and run back to the referee and say look at this.

text_blocks.text: No, you missing the play. I love it. I understand passion. Hold on, trust me, we be all right. We Martians now.

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Randolph
text_blocks.text: But you talking about a whole different play that I ain't even talking about today.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen on the Lakers' struggles and the upcoming trade deadline
quotes.excerpt: We're having an awful year. Me, Russ, AD, LeBron James. We're having an awful year.
quotes.quote: We're having an awful year. Me, Russ, AD, LeBron James. We're having an awful year. We're on the first road trip that if this road trip don't go right, forget it, I'm out of here. It's the truth of it. We tried this experiment, it didn't work. This is the first game on the road trip. We already know LeBron ain't playing in two of them. We already know that. AD just came back for this road trip. It's real. This shape where we going in the playoffs. I had one of my best games I ever had in the NBA. Play before that, I catch tip dunk for game.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen on his role and mindset with the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I got Jason Tatum, I'm picking his ass up. I got Jaylen Brown, I'm picking his ass up.
quotes.quote: I got Jason Tatum, I'm picking his ass up. I got Jaylen Brown, I'm picking his ass up. Yeah, it's up. Cool. I ain't getting traded. This about to change our whole year. Man get fouled, they don't call it. We lose. Not only do we lose, we lose to Brooklyn the next night, that people don't talk about. And the six-game win streak where we supposed to go four and two, we go two and four. Come back home, we got some talking to do.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen on Russell Westbrook's situation in Los Angeles
quotes.excerpt: Now they look at Westbrook crazy. Y'all losing. Same city he from.
quotes.quote: Now they look at Westbrook crazy. Y'all losing. Same city he from. Yeah, Crip. To my motherfucking UCLA, to my 2020, 2020, yeah cuz, rest in peace, Nipsey Hussle. So what you mean you trading Russell Westbrook out of LA? It changes. And for y'all, for y'all, and this is why I envy y'all so much because y'all have homes in the NBA. Y'all have places, Memphis, y'all can call home until it was over. Until it was fucking over. Players like me, when you a journey man, you got to keep finding your journey.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen on his relationship with coach Darvin Ham
quotes.excerpt: Darvin Ham, my man. Love him to death. He'll tell you this face to face.
quotes.quote: Darvin Ham, my man. Love him to death. He'll tell you this face to face. I told him from the beginning when he first got the job, I said you got to coach. I know you used to the East, this the West. Y'all West babies. The West is very different from the East. Coach Ham, you got to coach. You got to coach everybody. You can't get nobody no slack. He was fired the next year, and they won a cup. I see him in Vegas. I'm at the I'm at the win. I'm at the win, me and my lady, I'm at the win. I'm playing baccarat, I'm trying to get the closest to motherfucking nine. I see Darvin Ham walk past. He cannot talk to you for a minute, part of me want to say no.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen on receiving an apology from Darvin Ham
quotes.excerpt: I just want to tell you you was right. You and Russ was right.
quotes.quote: What's up, coach? He, you was right. Oh, what? He, I just want to tell you you was right. You and Russ was right. Y'all was the leaders of my team. You was right. You got Russ number. I need to apologize to him. Too late now. You mean? This man out of LA, they calling him Russbrick, they doing all these type of names about him. Yeah, he was Russ stretched every time. Every team out in his first one there. Straight professional. Your leaders was different. And he didn't know that.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen on leadership dynamics within the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: We know LeBron James is your leader. We know Anthony Davis is your leader.
quotes.quote: It wasn't your time to say LeBron James is my leader. We know fucking LeBron James is your leader. We know Anthony Davis is your leader. Come on man, we know I know Paul George and Kawhi Leonard are the leaders of the team. But it's different leaders. It's the people that got the heart and soul of the team, the team that you need the fucking engine to go for your car to get from point A to point B. And if you don't got that, I don't give a fuck what what kind of car you got. You could have a motherfucking Lamborghini, that motherfucking ain't getting there. I promise you.
